import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Format a log line as `[level] message` and print it to stdout."""
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_basic(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "Server started")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] Server started\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_different_levels(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "Disk full")
    log_line("DEBUG", "Connecting to port 8080")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[ERROR] Disk full\n[DEBUG] Connecting to port 8080\n"


def test_log_line_preserves_case_and_spacing(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "  low memory  ")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[warn]   low memory  \n"


def test_log_line_empty_strings(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[] \n"
